full.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of an esophageal biopsy stained with H&E. The section shows stratified squamous epithelium overlying a submucosa with dilated, congested vascular channels. These findings are characteristic of esophageal varices.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of tissue from the gastrointestinal system, specifically showing the esophageal mucosa and underlying submucosa and muscularis propria. The H&E stained section demonstrates normal stratified squamous epithelium lining the surface, with a subepithelial region containing connective tissue, blood vessels, and some scattered inflammation. The deepest layer shows intersecting bundles of smooth muscle fibers. No specific malignancy or infectious organism is definitively highlighted in this view.
